sloka: पापानां वा शुभानां वा वधार्हाणां प्लवङ्गम ।कार्यं करुणमार्येण न कश्चिन्नापराध्यति ।। ६.११६.४५ ।।
transliteration: pāpānāṁ vā śubhānāṁ vā vadhārhāṇāṁ plavaṅgama ।kāryaṁ karuṇamāryeṇa na kaścinnāparādhyati ।। 6.116.45 ।।

translations.english: "O Monkey! In olden days a bear had uttered a verse which conforms to righteousness. I shall tell you now."
